mapper.sql: SELECT t.labor_id, t.worker_name, t.id_card, t.phone, t.worker_type, t.dispatch_company, t.bank_name, t.bank_account, t.org_id, t.position_name, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.pay_type, t.daily_wage, t.agreement_no, t.to_regular, t.employee_id, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, d.dept_name AS org_name, e2.employee_name AS employee_name FROM biz_hr_labor_worker t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.org_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_hr_employee e2 ON t.employee_id = e2.employee_id
mapper.select:
t.(del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0') AND t.worker_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workerName}, '%') AND t.id_card LIKE CONCAT('%', #{idCard}, '%') AND t.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%') AND t.worker_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workerType}, '%') AND t.dispatch_company LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dispatchCompany}, '%') AND t.bank_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bankName}, '%') AND t.bank_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bankAccount}, '%') AND t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.position_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{positionName}, '%') AND t.start_date = #{startDate} AND t.end_date = #{endDate} AND t.pay_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{payType}, '%') AND t.daily_wage = #{dailyWage} AND t.agreement_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agreementNo}, '%') AND t.to_regular LIKE CONCAT('%', #{toRegular}, '%') AND t.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND t.status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{status}, '%') AND t.del_flag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{delFlag}, '%')
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_labor_worker SET del_flag = '2' WHERE labor_id = #{laborId}
UPDATE biz_hr_labor_worker SET del_flag = '2' WHERE labor_id IN #{laborId}
